sourceFile: 14. BRS-2015 Report test Suspension 201506 -A new vender WorldTop Vina_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies a real vendor validation but misstates the changed factor and omits key comparable outcomes.
issues: Changed factor should be new suspension vendor WorldTop Vina versus Normal, not filename.
Baseline and changed conditions are explicit in rows as Normal and Lot test/Test.
Outcomes omit NG assy/frame, spot welding, function, and module-line decision results.
Tension subresults have parsing errors: spec/sample rows treated as measurements and sample counts wrong.
Subgroup keys such as date, line, test round, and check type are not preserved.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to suspension 201506 new vendor WorldTop Vina validation against Normal lot.
Define baselineCondition as Normal and changedCondition as Lot test/Test.
Add outcome groups for assy/frame NG, spot welding NG, function NG, tension, and module-line 1st/2nd results.
Reparse tension rows by date, round, test/normal, item, spec, min, max, average, excluding header-derived stats.
Carry date, line, round, and check type as subgroup keys with row citations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are incomplete and partly misgrouped; more cited rows are needed before final use.
